claims.cytotoxic_mechanism: Raltegravir is a highly selective HIV integrase inhibitor with no activity against human cellular targets; at 2.5 uM it is expected to be largely inactive against human cancer cell lines.

raw.cytotoxic_mechanism: Raltegravir is a highly selective HIV integrase inhibitor with no activity against human cellular targets; at 2.5 uM it is expected to be largely inactive against human cancer cell lines.
